📢 We're Hiring: Power BI Developer
We are looking for an experienced Power BI Developer to join our team!
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in Power BI Development.
Strong experience in Power BI, DAX, data modeling, and dashboard development.
Excellent SQL skills and experience in data analysis.
Experience in developing interactive reports and business intelligence solutions.

Arabic Language Proficiency is MANDATORY.

Candidates who do not know Arabic should not apply.
📍 Location: Offshore / Onsite – Dubai
Interested candidates who meet the above requirements can share their updated resumes.
📩 Apply now or refer someone suitable!
